parameters.prompt: The exact upright horned yak demon king in the reference channels ONE great sealing spell in place. From the resting pose it slowly raises both arms high above the horned head with open palms facing the sky, the chest swelling, and holds the arms raised and trembling with effort for a long moment, then suddenly brings both fists down in front of the body into a low wide braced stance, holds the impact pose briefly, then straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, curved horns, dark shaggy mane, bracers, ornate belt, red kilt and tail. No jump, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: raise the arms over the first second, hold them raised until three seconds, a sudden downward release around three and a half seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
